correctness.rationale: For the corrected statement, invertibility balances the full prefix and independence of unrestricted restricted rows gives independent signed activations of probability 1/N. The geometric first activation divided by N tends to Exp(1); unless the next two positions activate (probability O(1/N)), the remaining tail changes the magnitude by at most one quarter of its first term. Exact cancellation would require an infinite maximal opposite-sign tail and has probability zero. Quantile convergence gives the stated absolute median scale. Independent uniforms within disjoint nested-scramble strata give variance 1/(12N³), a Gaussian standardized limit and zero limit on the scaled logarithmic axis. The supplied verify.py was inspected, not executed; the recorded VERIFY_OK 96 supports finite digit distributions and moments only.
